acknowledge.doc: Mark a specific channel message as read/acknowledged by the current user. Broadcasts the updated message state to all other participants in the hub via WebSocket, excluding the sender's socket.

message_id.doc: ID of the message to acknowledge

socket_id.doc: Caller's WebSocket socket ID. Used to exclude the caller from the broadcast recipients.

acknowledge_ticket.doc: Mark a support ticket message as read/acknowledged. Broadcasts the acknowledgement to all support domain members and to the current user's own sockets.

message_id.doc: ID of the ticket message to acknowledge

ticket_id.doc: ID of the ticket that contains the message

returns.doc: Acknowledgement result from acknowledge_message procedure executed on the ticket owner's sharebox hub

clear_notifications.doc: Clear all channel notifications for the current user. Broadcasts an empty payload to the user's sockets and clears the notification records in the database.

delete.doc: Delete one or more channel messages. Supports two deletion modes: me (hide from the current user only) or all (delete for all participants, restricted to message author). Broadcasts deletions to hub participants and cleans up any attached files from the file system.

option.doc: Deletion scope. Must be me (hide for current user only) or all (delete for all, author only).

messages.doc: Array of message IDs to delete

returns.doc: List of deleted message records after processing, including attachment cleanup results

errors.message: option is not me or all, or option is all but current user is not the message author
One or more provided message IDs do not exist

enter.doc: Public channel entry point. Accepts an optional message payload and echoes it back. Used for DMZ or guest-level channel access.

message.doc: Optional message content. Defaults to empty string.
The message value as provided (or empty string)

list_tickets.doc: List support tickets for the current user with optional status filter, pagination, and ticket ID search. Retrieves tickets from the user's sharebox (wicket) hub.

status.doc: Array of status values to filter by. Defaults to new.

ticket_id.doc: Optional ticket ID to search for a specific ticket within the results

returns.doc: List of ticket records with metadata parsed from JSON

live_message.doc: Public live message endpoint. Accepts an optional message payload and echoes it back. Used for real-time guest or DMZ channel interactions.

message.doc: Optional message content. Defaults to empty string.
The message value as provided (or empty string)

messages.doc: Retrieve paginated channel messages for the current hub. Enriches each message with author contact information, thread context for replies, and broadcasts an acknowledge signal to all other hub participants.

order.doc: Sort order for messages. asc for oldest first, desc for newest first. Defaults to asc.

returns.doc: Paginated list of enriched message objects

entity.doc: Author contact information from shareroom_contact_get procedure. For messages by the current user, contains only id.

thread.doc: Thread context object if the message is a reply (only present when thread_id is set)

notify.doc: Retrieve channel notification data for the current user. Alias for notify_chat.

returns.doc: Notification data from channel_notify_messages procedure for the current user

post.doc: Post a new message to the current hub channel. Supports text messages, threaded replies, and file attachments. Moves attachment files to the appropriate sharebox directory and broadcasts the new message to all hub participants except the sender.

message.doc: Text content of the message. Defaults to empty string. Single quotes are automatically escaped.

thread_id.doc: Message ID of the parent message to reply to. Creates a threaded reply when provided.

attachment.doc: Array of file node IDs to attach to the message. Files are moved to the message directory in the sharebox hub.

socket_id.doc: Caller's WebSocket socket ID. Used to exclude the caller from the broadcast recipients.

echoId.doc: Client-side echo identifier for optimistic UI updates

is_attachment.doc: 1 if the message has attachments, 0 otherwise

thread.doc: Thread context if thread_id was provided

firstname.doc: First name of the message author

lastname.doc: Last name of the message author

hub_id.doc: ID of the hub where the message was posted

post_ticket.doc: Post a reply message to an existing support ticket. Supports threaded replies and file attachments. Broadcasts the new message to the ticket owner and all support domain members.

ticket_id.doc: ID of the ticket to post a reply to

message.doc: Text content of the reply. Defaults to empty string.

thread_id.doc: Message ID of the parent message to reply to within the ticket thread

attachment.doc: Array of file node IDs to attach to the ticket reply

echoId.doc: Client-side echo identifier for optimistic UI updates

is_attachment.doc: 1 if the reply has attachments, 0 otherwise

thread.doc: Thread context if thread_id was provided

ticket_id.doc: ID of the ticket this reply belongs to

errors.message: No ticket found with the given ticket_id

read.doc: Mark all messages in a channel as read up to a given message ID for the current user.

id.doc: Message ID up to which all messages are marked as read via channel_read_messages procedure

send_ticket.doc: Create a new support ticket with an initial message. Optionally includes file attachments, category tags, affected areas, and recurrence flag. Automatically sends an auto-reply, broadcasts to the ticket owner and all support domain members.

message.doc: Initial ticket message content. Single quotes are automatically escaped.

category.doc: Array of category tags for the ticket (e.g. tech, design, enhancement, notunderstand)

attachment.doc: Array of file node IDs to attach to the ticket. Defaults to empty array.

where.doc: Array of platform area identifiers where the issue occurred (e.g. desktop, chat, teamroom). Defaults to empty array.

alltime.doc: Flag indicating if the issue is recurring. Defaults to 0.

echoId.doc: Client-side echo identifier for optimistic UI updates

ticket_id.doc: ID of the newly created ticket

is_attachment.doc: 1 if the ticket has attachments, 0 otherwise

firstname.doc: First name of the ticket submitter

lastname.doc: Last name of the ticket submitter

org_name.doc: Organisation name of the ticket submitter

metadata.doc: Ticket metadata including status, category, where, and attachment info

show_ticket.doc: Retrieve the full message thread for a support ticket including author contact enrichment, metadata parsing, category and location display labels, and thread context for replies. Broadcasts acknowledgement signals to support members for newly read messages.

ticket_id.doc: ID of the ticket whose messages to retrieve

returns.doc: List of enriched ticket message records

entity.doc: Author contact information from shareroom_contact_get procedure

metadata.doc: Parsed message metadata including category_display and where_display label arrays for ticket messages

thread.doc: Thread context object if the message is a reply

to_read.doc: Get the number of unread message pages for the current user in the channel. Alias for pages_to_read.

returns.doc: Unread page count result from pages_to_read procedure

update_ticket.doc: Update the metadata (e.g. status) of an existing support ticket. Restricted to users belonging to the configured support domain. Broadcasts the updated ticket to the ticket owner and all support domain members.

ticket_id.doc: ID of the ticket to update

status.doc: New status value to set on the ticket metadata

returns.doc: Updated ticket record with metadata parsed from JSON

errors.message: Current user does not belong to the configured support domain
No ticket found with the given ticket_id
